svg.text: ORION ASIC — Tape-out to Production Ramp
Design: RTL, tape-out and the A1 respin.
Product engineering: Fabrication lots, PVT and the production ramp.
Validation: Bring-up, EVT and DVT on each silicon revision.
Lot A0-L3 not yet matched to a work package.
Customer review scheduled with the A1 lot.
A1 respin decision is taken from A0 characterization data, not from EVT alone.
